nextStoryContext: US-R1-003 closed the real-I/O test gap the review finding named: `defaultListProcesses` (src/commands/stop.ts, the function that shells out to real `ps -eo pid,args` + `lsof -a -d cwd -p <pid> -F n`) had never been exercised by anything other than hand-built ProcessRecord fixtures fed directly into `matchesSidecarForProject`, across all three prior stories that changed it (US-004/US-R1-001/US-R1-002). Added `test/integration/stop-defaultlistprocesses-real.test.ts`: spawns a REAL child process shaped exactly like the interpreted self-spawn argv (`[process.execPath, scriptPath, 'sidecar']`) plus an adjacent same-cwd process whose last argv token is NOT 'sidecar', in a real `mkdtemp`+`realpathSync`'d temp cwd, then drives both through `performStop({ cwd })` with NO `listProcessesFn` override -- the production default (`defaultListProcesses`) performs the real scan+discovery+SIGTERM. Asserts the sidecar-shaped process is found and killed (confirmed dead via signal-0 probe) and the adjacent process is untouched (still alive). `lsof` was not previously a tracked dependency in test/helpers/test-deps.ts; added as an 8th DepName, classified 'legitimate-environmental' (absent in the oven/bun-slim worker-container image, same rationale as `ps`), with a new `lsofAvailable` export and a `test.skipIf(!psAvailable || !lsofAvailable)` gate on the new test. Full quality spine (typecheck, 5934 tests, check:all incl. coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity/agents-md/test-sleeps/skip-ratchet) is green; no file-size-budget.json changes were needed (new/modified files stayed under existing or unbudgeted ceilings). GOTCHA recorded in patterns.md for future real-I/O tests: (1) `lsof` reports the REALPATH cwd (macOS `/tmp` symlinks to `/private/tmp`), so compare/pass the `realpathSync()`'d mkdtemp path, not the raw one; (2) `check:test-sleeps` regex-matches `setTimeout`-inside-`new Promise` patterns as STRING TEXT too (not just live code) -- a string literal holding a spawned child-script's own idle-loop source gets flagged as a 'fixed sleep' even though it never executes in the test's own control flow; suppress with an inline `// CAM-NNN: ...` tracker-ref comment on the SAME line as the literal. Only one round-1 review finding remains open (US-R1-004, already specified in the prior two handoffs, see openQuestions).

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed Bun.spawn(cmd[], { cwd, ... }) shape and default SIGTERM kill signal; noted the docs recommend individual stdin/stdout/stderr options over the Node-compat `stdio: [...]` array this test uses -- kept the existing codebase convention (test/integration/stop-sidecar-real.test.ts already uses `stdio: [...]`) rather than diverging style for one new test file, per surgical-change discipline.
